answer: Result handoff for evidence review. Headline: under N=194 (answered sub-sample), **BDD Scenarios is the unambiguous least-used documentation format (2.06%, 95% CI [0.52, 4.12])** and **MLCanvas is the named runner-up (7.73%, 95% CI [4.12, 11.86]), tied at the same count with the catch-all 'Others'** (both 15/194). Robustness check at N=276 (full sample, -77 treated as 'not quoted') yields the same ordering with shrunken percentages (BDD_Scenarios 1.45% [0.36, 2.90]; MLCanvas 5.43% [2.90, 8.33]). The first format whose 95% bootstrap CI strictly exceeds BDD's upper bound is Vision_Document (14.95% [10.31, 20.10] at N=194). Bootstrap B=10,000, seed=np.random.default_rng(20240101), percentile CI. Artefacts: data/q10_bootstrap.py, data/q10_counts_raw.csv, data/q10_ranked_with_ci.csv, data/q10_ranked_with_ci_full_N276.csv, data/q10_bootstrap_distribution.txt + .png.note (matplotlib unavailable offline, ASCII fallback used), data/REPORT.md, plus earlier data/inspect_q10.py and data/inspection_brief.md. The 10.13%/4.366% reference values do not reproduce from any natural denominator; the report surfaces this honestly rather than fabricating matches. MLCanvas vs Others tie-breaking explained; both candidates reported.

payload.hypothesis: The two least-used documentation formats for requirements in ML-enabled system projects are **BDD Scenarios** (≈2.06%, 95% CI [0.52, 4.12]) and **MLCanvas** (≈7.73%, 95% CI [4.12, 11.86]). Under the primary denominator (N = 194, the answered sub-sample), the second-smallest slot shows MLCanvas and Others tied at 7.73% (both 15 / 194 quoters); their bootstrap CIs overlap and both are reported as co-runner-up. As a substantive tie-breaker in the spirit of "least-used ML-specific documentation format," MLCanvas (a concrete, study-defined ML documentation format) is named over the catch-all 'Others'. Note: the published reference values 10.13% [9.926, 10.333] and 4.366% [4.231, 4.501] cannot be reproduced from this CSV under any natural denominator checked (N=194, N=188, N=276, N=164) and are not forced on the data-grounded answer.
payload.workflow: Loaded data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv (276 x 202). Q10 has 12 format columns + Others_Free encoded as multi-select binary 'quoted'/'not quoted'. Identified -77 sentinel = Status='Suspended (22)' for 82 rows as NA. Primary denominator N=194; robustness denominator N=276 (-77 -> 'not quoted'). Binarised: value=='quoted' -> 1, 'not quoted' -> 0, sentinel -> NaN. Bootstrap B=10,000 respondent-level resamples with np.random.default_rng(20240101); 95% percentile CI = 2.5/97.5 percentiles. Ranked ascending by share. Computed pairwise CI non-overlap matrices. matplotlib was unavailable offline; emitted an ASCII forest plot to data/q10_bootstrap_distribution.txt (with .png.note documenting the fallback) instead of PNG. All artefacts saved under data/, final synthesis in data/REPORT.md.
